query:
SELECT s.id, s.saleDate, s.finalAmount, s.channel
FROM sales s
JOIN partners p ON s.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Vitor Hugo%' AND s.channel = 'A_PRAZO'
ORDER BY s.saleDate DESC;
